name: menuconfig
description: Kconfig graphical configuration for VS Code, powered by Kconfiglib. Edit .config and generate the C header (autoconf.h).

menuconfig.pythonPath.description: Path to the Python interpreter (3.8+). Leave empty to auto-detect python, py -3 or python3.

enumDescriptions: Run Kconfiglib's own UI (ncurses menuconfig or Tk guiconfig) in an integrated terminal.
Use the VS Code webview panel shipped with this extension.
menuconfig.ui.description: Which configuration UI "Menuconfig: Open Configuration" launches.

enumDescriptions: Use the curses UI when the terminal supports it, otherwise the Tk UI.
Force the curses UI (vendor/menuconfig.py). Needs an interactive terminal.
Force the Tk UI (vendor/guiconfig.py). Opens as a separate window.

menuconfig.menuconfigStyle.description: Value of MENUCONFIG_STYLE for Kconfiglib's curses UI.

menuconfig.generateHeaderAfterUi.description: After the Kconfiglib UI exits, regenerate the C header from the saved .config.

menuconfig.searchRoot.description: Directory scanned recursively for Kconfig files.

menuconfig.headerPath.description: Output path of the generated C header. The generated aggregate Kconfig and the default .config live in this directory.

menuconfig.configPath.description: Path of the .config file. Leave empty to use <header directory>/.config.

menuconfig.kconfigName.description: File name treated as a Kconfig file while scanning.

menuconfig.aggregateName.description: File name of the generated aggregate Kconfig.

enumDescriptions: Aggregate only files that are not already pulled in by another discovered file (no duplicated menus).
Aggregate every discovered Kconfig file, exactly like menuconfig.py.
menuconfig.aggregateMode.description: How discovered Kconfig files are combined into the aggregate Kconfig.

menuconfig.env.description: Extra environment variables for Kconfiglib, e.g. {"ARCH": "arm", "SRCARCH": "arm"}. 'srctree' is set automatically.

menuconfig.includeGuard.description: Wrap the generated header in an include guard (#ifndef _<NAME>_H_).

menuconfig.saveOldConfig.description: Keep a copy of the previous .config as .config.old when the Webview panel saves. Kconfiglib's terminal UI always writes .config.old itself.

menuconfig.showStatusBar.description: Show the "menuconfig" button in the status bar. It is also hidden automatically when no folder is open.
